met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Firozpur, Muzaffarnagar, Barabanki, Chapra, Jamshedpur, Digha and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from south Gujarat to the cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Biharacross Madhya Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough now runs from north Telangana to Gulf of Mannar across south Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhoodat 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Westcentral bay of Bengal & adjoining Coastal Andhra Pradesh at 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Andaman sea & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists. Under its influence, a Low Pressure Area is likely to form over westcentral-Northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining north Andhra Pradesh- south Odisha coasts around 11th September.
